WITH SchoolFreeMealRates AS (
    SELECT 
        s.CDSCode,
        AVG(s.FRPM_Count_K-12 / s.Enrollment_K-12) AS CountyAverageFreeMealRate
    FROM 
        frpm s
    WHERE 
        s.County_Name = 'Alameda'
    GROUP BY 
        s.CDSCode
),
SchoolsWithHighestFreeMealRate AS (
    SELECT 
        s.*
    FROM 
        frpm s
    JOIN 
        SchoolFreeMealRates sfmr ON s.CDSCode = sfmr.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        s.FRPM_Count_K-12 / s.Enrollment_K-12 = MAX(sfmr.FRPM_Count_K-12 / s.Enrollment_K-12)
)
SELECT 
    swhfr.CDSCode,
    swhfr.CharterSchool (Y/N) AS IsCharterSchool,
    swhfr.GSserved AS GradesServed,
    swhfr.SATPerformanceLevel AS SATPerformanceLevel,
    swhfr.FRPM_Count_K-12 / swhfr.Enrollment_K-12 - sfmr.CountyAverageFreeMealRate AS FreeMealRateDeviation
FROM 
    SchoolsWithHighestFreeMealRate swhfr
JOIN 
    SchoolFreeMealRates sfmr ON swhfr.CDSCode = sfmr.CDSCode

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School AS SchoolName,
    ss.AvgScrMath AS AvgMathScore,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN s2.cds = s.CDSCode THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 AS SATPerformanceRanking,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.rtype = 'S' AND s.enroll12 > 0 THEN s.NumTstTakr ELSE 0 END) / SUM(s.NumTstTakr) AS PovertyLevel
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE 
    s.Virtual = 'F' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400
GROUP BY 
    s.CDSCode, s.School, ss.AvgScrMath
ORDER BY 
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.rtype = 'S' AND s.enroll12 > 0 THEN s.NumTstTakr ELSE 0 END) / SUM(s.NumTstTakr), AVG(ss.AvgScrMath)

SELECT 
    s.cds AS cds,
    s.rtype AS rtype,
    s.sname AS school_name,
    s.dname AS district_name,
    s.cname AS county_name,
    s.enroll12 AS enrollment_ages_5_to_17,
    s.NumTstTakr AS num_test_takers,
    AVG(s.AvgScrRead) AS avg_reading_score,
    AVG(s.AvgScrMath) AS avg_math_score,
    AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_writing_score,
    s.NumGE1500 AS num_ge_1500,
    (s.NumGE1500 / s.NumTstTakr) * 100 AS excellence_rate
FROM 
    satscores s
WHERE 
    s.cds IN (
        SELECT 
            cds 
        FROM 
            schools 
        WHERE 
            rtype = 'S' AND Magnet = 1 AND NumTstTakr > 500
    )
GROUP BY 
    s.cds, s.rtype, s.sname, s.dname, s.cname, s.enroll12, s.NumTstTakr, AVG(s.AvgScrRead), AVG(s.AvgScrMath), AVG(s.AvgScrWrite), s.NumGE1500
ORDER BY 
    (AVG(s.AvgScrRead) + AVG(s.AvgScrMath) + AVG(s.AvgScrWrite)) / 3 DESC

    SELECT 
        cds,

        AVG(AvgScrMath) AS avg_math_score,

    ss.avg_read_score AS avg_read_score,
    ss.avg_math_score AS avg_math_score,

    ranked_schools rs

WITH colusa_humboldt AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.CDSCode = c.CDSCode THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(c.CDSCode) AS total_schools,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.CDSCode = c.CDSCode AND s.Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(c.CDSCode) AS charter_schools_colusa_humboldt_ratio,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.CDSCode = c.CDSCode AND (c.Percent_%_Eligible_FRPM_(K-12) > 0.5 OR c.Percent_%_Eligible_FRPM_(Ages 5-17) > 0.5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(c.CDSCode) AS high_free_meal_eligibility_colusa_humboldt_ratio,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.CDSCode = c.CDSCode AND s.rtype = 'S' THEN AVGScrRead + AVGScrMath + AVGScrWrite ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(c.CDSCode) AS avg_sat_scores_colusa_humboldt_ratio,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.CDSCode = c.CDSCode AND s.rtype = 'S' THEN FreeMealCount(K-12) + FreeMealCount(Ages 5-17) ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(c.CDSCode) AS total_free_meals_colusa_humboldt_ratio,

    s.NCESDist AS NCESDistrictID,

        ELSE 'Non-Charter'
    END AS CharterStatus,

        WHEN s.StatusType IN ('Active', 'Pending') THEN 'Operational'

        WHEN s.Percent__Eligible_FRPM_K-12 BETWEEN 25 AND 50 THEN 'Low Poverty'

    ss.AvgScrRead AS AvgReadScore,

FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE 
    s.SOC LIKE '3%' OR s.DOCType = 'State Special Schools'

LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id

WITH female_account_owners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM account
    JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    WHERE gender = 'F' AND type = 'OWNER'
), loan_details AS (
    SELECT 
        ao.account_id,
        SUM(loan.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS num_loans,
        MAX(CASE WHEN loan.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_status_count,
        MAX(CASE WHEN loan.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS default_status_count
    FROM account ao
    JOIN loan ON ao.account_id = loan.account_id
    WHERE ao.gender = 'F'
    AND ao.type = 'OWNER'
    GROUP BY ao.account_id
), card_details AS (
    SELECT 
        ao.account_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.type = 'junior' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_junior_card,
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.type = 'classic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_classic_card,
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.type = 'gold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_gold_card
    FROM account ao
    JOIN card c ON ao.account_id = c.card_id
    WHERE ao.gender = 'F'
    AND ao.type = 'OWNER'
    GROUP BY ao.account_id
), client_details AS (
    SELECT 
        ao.account_id,
        AVG(trans.balance) AS avg_balance,
        COUNT(*) AS num_transactions,
        SUM(CASE WHEN trans.k_symbol = 'UVER' THEN trans.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_loan_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN trans.k_symbol IN ('SIPO', 'DUCHOD') THEN -trans.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
        SUM(trans.amount) AS total_expense
    FROM account ao
    JOIN client cl ON ao.district_id = cl.district_id
    JOIN trans ON ao.account_id = trans.account_id
    WHERE ao.gender = 'F'
    AND ao.type = 'OWNER'
    GROUP BY ao.account_id
), savings_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        ao.account_id,
        (total_income - total_expense) / total_income * 100 AS savings_rate
    FROM account ao
    JOIN client cl ON ao.district_id = cl.district_id
    JOIN trans t ON ao.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE ao.gender = 'F'
    AND ao.type = 'OWNER'
), regional_loan_ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        district_id,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY district_id) AS loan_count,
        AVG(total_loan_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY district_id) AS avg_loan_amount,
        A16 - A15 AS crime_rate
    FROM loan
    JOIN district ON loan.district_id = district.district_id
)
SELECT 
    ao.account_id,
    ao.gender,
    ao.type,
    c.has_junior_card,
    c.has_classic_card,
    c.has_gold_card,
    ld.avg_balance,
    ld.num_transactions,
    ld.total_loan_amount AS total_loans,
    ld.good_status_count * 100 / COUNT(*) AS good_status_percentage,
    ld.default_status_count * 100 / COUNT(*) AS default_status_percentage,
    sr.savings_rate,
    rr.loan_count,
    rr.avg_loan_amount,
    rr.crime_rate
FROM female_account_owners ao
JOIN loan_details ld ON ao.account_id = ld.account_id
LEFT JOIN card_details c ON ao.account_id = c.account_id
LEFT JOIN client_details ld ON ao.account_id = ld.account_id
LEFT JOIN savings_rate sr ON ao.account_id = sr.account_id
LEFT JOIN regional_loan_ranking rr ON ao.district_id = rr.district_id
WHERE ao.gender = 'F' AND ao.type = 'OWNER'
ORDER BY total_loans DESC
LIMIT 100

    COUNT(c.card_id) AS classic_card_holders_count,
    AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount,
    AVG(a.balance) AS average_account_balance,
    AVG(o.amount) AS average_order_amount,
    AVG(t.amount) AS average_transaction_amount,
    AVG(l.duration) AS average_loan_duration,
    AVG(l.payments) AS average_loan_payments,
    AVG(d.A11) AS district_avg_salary,
    AVG(d.A12) AS district_unemployment_rate
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    card cr ON c.client_id = cr.client_id
JOIN 
    account a ON d.disp_id = a.disp_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND l.status = 'A'
LEFT JOIN 
    order o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 
    cr.type = 'classic' AND d.A11 > 0 AND d.A2 IN ('OWNER')
GROUP BY 
    d.A2

SELECT 
    c.gender,
    CASE 
        WHEN c.age BETWEEN 0 AND 29 THEN 'Young'
        WHEN c.age BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN 'Middle-aged'
        ELSE 'Senior'
    END AS age_group,
    AVG(a.frequency) AS average_frequency,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts,
    SUM(CASE 
             WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
             ELSE 0
          END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
                               WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.trans_id
                              END) * 100 AS average_income_percentage,
    SUM(CASE 
           WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount
           ELSE 0
      END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
                             WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.trans_id
                            END) * 100 AS average_expense_percentage,
    AVG(t.balance) AS average_balance
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN 
    account a ON c.client_id = a.account_id AND d.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON c.client_id = t.account_id AND d.district_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
    c.gender = 'M' AND d.A2 = 'Prague'
GROUP BY 
    c.gender, age_group

    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

                ELSE 'Senior'
            END AS age_category
        FROM 
            client
        GROUP BY 
            district_id
    ) t ON c.district_id = t.district_id
WHERE 
    l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan)

    (SUM(CASE WHEN t.date >= '19950101' AND t.date < '19960101' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM loan t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(CASE WHEN T2.element = 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 0
        ELSE 100
    END AS percentage_no_f,
    AVG(CASE WHEN T2.element IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100 AS avg_atoms_per_mol,
    AVG(CASE WHEN T2.element = 'f' THEN bond_strength ELSE NULL END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.element = 'f' THEN bond_strength END) AS avg_bond_strength_with_f,
    AVG(CASE WHEN T2.element != 'f' THEN bond_strength ELSE NULL END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.element != 'f' THEN bond_strength END) AS avg_bond_strength_without_f
FROM 
    molecule M
JOIN 
    atom A ON M.molecule_id = A.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN 
    atom T2 ON A.atom_id = T2.atom_id2 AND M.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN 
    bond B ON B.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN 
    connected C ON C.atom_id = A.atom_id AND C.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id2
JOIN 
    bond_strength BS ON BS.bond_id = B.bond_id
WHERE 
    M.label = '+'
AND 
    (T2.element IS NULL OR T2.element != 'f')

sql:
WITH bond_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bond_id,
        COUNT(*) AS bond_count,
        GROUP_CONCAT(a.element) AS elements_connected,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 1 THEN 'Multiple' ELSE 'Single' END AS bond_frequency
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        atom a ON b.bond_id = a.bond_id
    WHERE 
        b.molecule_id = 'TR000'
    GROUP BY 
        b.bond_id, elements_connected
),
bond_types AS (
    SELECT 
        bond_id,
        bond_type,
        bond_count,
        elements_connected,
        bond_frequency
    FROM 
        bond_counts
)
SELECT 
    bt.bond_type,
    bt.bond_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(bt.elements_connected, ' ', 1), ' ', -1)) OVER (PARTITION BY bt.bond_id) AS unique_element_pairs,
    bt.bond_frequency,
    m.label
FROM 
    bond_types bt
JOIN 
    molecule m ON bt.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
ORDER BY 
    bt.bond_count DESC

GROUP BY T1.name
ORDER BY T1.name;

    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_superheroes
    FROM superhero
), bad_alignment_percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN alignment_id = (SELECT id FROM alignment WHERE alignment = 'Bad') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*)
    FROM superhero
), bad_alignment_count AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN alignment_id = (SELECT id FROM alignment WHERE alignment = 'Bad') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_bad_alignments
    FROM superhero
)
SELECT 
    CAST(total_bad_alignments AS REAL) / COUNT(*) * 100 AS percentage_of_bad_alignments,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE publisher_id = (SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')) AS count_marvel_superheroes
FROM bad_alignment_count, superhero_count;
```

WITH player_weights AS (
    SELECT 
        P.player_api_id,
        SUM(T.weight) / COUNT(*) AS avg_weight
    FROM Player P
    JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.away_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.away_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.away_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.away_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.away_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.away_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.away_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.away_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.away_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.away_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_11)
    GROUP BY P.player_api_id
), country_weights AS (
    SELECT 
        C.id,
        AVG(PW.avg_weight) AS avg_weight
    FROM Country C
    JOIN League L ON C.id = L.country_id
    JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON L.id = TA.league_id
    JOIN Match M ON M.league_id = L.id
    JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_1 OR PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_1 OR PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_2 OR PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_2 OR PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_3 OR PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_3 OR PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_4 OR PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_4 OR PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_5 OR PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_5 OR PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_6 OR PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_6 OR PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_7 OR PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_7 OR PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_8 OR PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_8 OR PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_9 OR PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_9 OR PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_10 OR PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_10 OR PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_11 OR PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_11
    JOIN player_weights PW ON PW.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
    WHERE C.id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT T.team_fifa_api_id 
        FROM Team T 
        JOIN Match M ON T.team_fifa_api_id = M.home_team_api_id OR T.team_fifa_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
        WHERE M.match_api_id IN (
            SELECT match_api_id 
            FROM Match 
            GROUP BY match_api_id 
            HAVING COUNT(*) >= 22
        )
    )
    GROUP BY C.id
)

    END) AS PercentageInPatient,

    CASE 
        WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN T2.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(T1.amount) > 
              SUM(CASE WHEN T2.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(T1.amount)
        THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS advertisement_ratio
FROM 
    budget AS T1
JOIN 
    event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id

    T1.category = 'Advertisement' AND T2.event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting')

    CASE 
        WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN T2.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(T1.amount) > 
              SUM(CASE WHEN T2.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(T1.amount)
        THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS advertisement_ratio
FROM 
    budget AS T1
JOIN 
    event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id
WHERE 
    T1.category = 'Advertisement' AND T2.event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting')
GROUP BY 
    T1.budget_id;
```

        ELSE 'Lowest Increase' END AS IncreaseDecreaseType
FROM (
    SELECT 
        t.Segment,
        (t.Increase / t.Total2012) * 100 AS PercentageIncrease
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            y.Segment,

            SUM(y.Consumption) AS Total2012
        FROM yearmonth y
        LEFT JOIN yearmonth x ON y.CustomerID = x.CustomerID AND YEAR(y.Date) = 2012 AND MONTH(y.Date) = x.Month
        WHERE y.Date LIKE '2013%'
        GROUP BY y.Segment
    ) t
) subquery
ORDER BY PercentageIncrease DESC
